en: "But its shape and color differ from{n} the ones around here. Custom-built,{n} or is it an old model?"
"Looks like it broke down{n} a good while ago."
"It's probably been saying the same{n} thing in this spot for decades,{n} centuries... no, millennia."
"I SLEPT...{w:1} A LONG TIME...{n} BUT...{w:1} MY BODY...{w:1} IS HEAVY..."
"A PART...{w:1} OF MY BODY...{w:1} HAS BEEN{n} ...TAKEN...{w:1} BY SOMEONE..."
"A part of your body, you say?"
"True, the lid on its chest is open.{n} Looks like a component in here{n} has been pulled out, but..."
"Well, it's nothing but junk, that's{n} for sure. A waste of time. Right now{n} I've got to press on, even a little."
"What's this? The part I traded for{n} in town has suddenly started{n} giving off light?"
"Almost as if it's reacting{n} to this clunker?"
"This part, if I recall, was called{n} a Crystal Photon Brain Unit..."
"So this part that started glowing is{n} the 'part of its body' that was{n} pulled out of the clunker."
"Still, the model looks different, but{n} this one's an island Defense Machine{n} too."
"Whether it's a good idea{n} to wake it up..."
Fit the part in its chest
"It was a long sleep. Where am I?{n} What am I doing here?"
"Are you a human? Why?{n} How can a human be{n} on this island?"
"Who knows. But these days the island{n} is where humans fight their wars. It{n} has more people than a fair-sized capital."
"I see. I do not know the reason,{n} but it seems the seal on this land{n} has been broken."
"And you were surprised to see that{n} I'm human. So how come you can{n} speak the human tongue?"
"We were made by the gods. Even the{n} words I speak now are no more than{n} an imitation of the gods' language."
"So you're saying I'm a god, too?"
"I don't get it. Not one bit."
"Well, never mind. By the way,{n} do you know this island well?"
"How many thousands of years have{n} passed since then? It seems I{n} slept far, far too long..."
"Then do you know what the treasure{n} sleeping on this island really is?"
"I do not know. No, I cannot recall.{n} My sleep was too deep. My memory{n} was wiped away all at once."
"I cannot recall. What has happened?{n} There was something I had to do.{n} I cannot even recall what it was."
"It all lies far away in the past..."
"I had a certain purpose. I was{n} trying to accomplish something,{n} even betraying my comrades for it."
"I've wasted my time. So long,{n} clunker. Sit there remembering{n} the past forever."
"Is this statue resonating with the{n} ring I got at Special Service HQ,{n} the 'Twelve Keys' ring or whatever?"
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Hey, hey, what's going on here?{n} The statue's yapping away!"
"My name is Sky God Uranus, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"Hmph, a well-made machine. It reacts{n} to whoever holds a ring and talks{n} automatically. That's the trick."
"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
"When you have gathered all twelve{n} rings, we shall acknowledge you{n} as the agent of the gods."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"The seal on us Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} has been broken after a hundred years."
"Agent of the gods, huh?{n} Set the course of this world right, huh?"
"Man, what a roundabout way to talk.{n} Basically, I just have to collect{n} twelve rings lying around somewhere."
"And if I do, I get my hands on{n} some incredible power, right?"
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"Now is the time to fulfill{n} the ancient covenant."
"Now that's a well-made gimmick.{n} In the blink of an eye, the statue{n} turned into this tiny little ring."
"These Ancient Gods who made it{n} must've really loved theatrics."
"Then again, it's sure to be a hit{n} with military men who love theatrics.{n} So bad they can taste it..."
"This ring's supposed to be a key,{n} right? So if I collect twelve, I get{n} to lay eyes on the Almighty Treasure?"
"Looks like this trip just got{n} a bit more interesting."
"It's resonating with the ring I have."
"So that's one step closer to the{n} so-called Almighty Treasure{n} sleeping on this island."
"By the way, clunker,{n} can you use Voids?"
"Look, the ones loaded on that Carrier.{n} Automatic attack weapons built from{n} machinery, like little brothers to you."
"They resemble us in shape, but they{n} seem to be fundamentally different{n} machines."
"Machines that understand human{n} speech and move like humans."
"No problem. I can control them.{n} They should obey my word, just as{n} they obey you humans."
"Good enough. Depending on how things{n} go, I'll assign Voids to you too.{n} We're short on people, you see."
"No, I am glad.{n} You treated me as a person."
"Well, it's nothing but junk, that's{n} for sure. A waste of time. Right now{n} I've got to press on, even a little."
"Well, one Defense Machine{n} is nothing to worry about."
"Besides, this one speaks human{n} language. With luck, I may get to{n} hear the island's secrets from it."
"That's right. A part of your body."
"I do not know. But I must go.{n} That alone is etched{n} in my memory."
"The one clue to knowing myself{n} is simply to move forward..."
"But my sleep was too deep.{n} To move forward, I need{n} someone's help..."
"Please. Will you take me with you?"
"I will never be a burden. Let me{n} accompany you on your journey."
"It is the one and only way to regain{n} myself: the best course my crystal{n} photon brain has computed."
"What will you do, Lt. {hero:6}?{n} It is a Machine Soldier, after all.{n} We can't trust it carelessly...?"
"No. Either way, we're short on{n} fighting strength ourselves. I'd{n} take a hand from a cat right now."
"You are the commander, Lt. {hero:6}.{n} I leave the rest to you..."
"And here's the important point: if{n} you meet Defense Machines of your own{n} kind, can you take them down?"
"You machines of the same kind won't{n} team up and come after me,{n} will you?"
"I am FD-3S: a super A-class droid{n} bearing the codes Fight and Destroy,{n} Type 3, Special Version."
"I stand alone, as an individual.{n} There are none of my kind. Of course,{n} I can also fight Machine Soldiers."
"Then take up duty as my bodyguard.{n} If you can do that,{n} I'll take you along."
"I must go. For that, I will even{n} obey the word of a human.{n} In order to regain myself..."
"But if things get dicey, I'll leave{n} you behind any time.{n} Just remember that much."
"My name is Sky God Uranus, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."

"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"

"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
